# 📓 Notebook Review Checklist

- [ ] Clear educational objective.
- [ ] Synthetic or appropriately licensed data.
- [ ] Python/package versions recorded.
- [ ] Random seeds explicit when required.
- [ ] Cells run top-to-bottom in a clean kernel.
- [ ] Outputs contain no private paths or secrets.
- [ ] Algorithm assumptions explained.
- [ ] Metrics use valid evaluation data.
- [ ] Large outputs cleared.
- [ ] Links to canonical source/docs.
